chunks: And it is narrated from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī al-Washshāʾ, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about visiting the grave of Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام—whether it is like the visitation of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام. He said, “Yes.”

key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ: Abū al-Ḥasan; honorific title referring here to Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام
key_terms.زِيَارَةِ: visitation; devotional visiting of a sacred grave
key_terms.قَبْرِ: grave; the burial place being visited
key_terms.مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar al-Kāẓim عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: Is visiting the grave of Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام like visiting Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī al-Washshāʾ asked Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام whether visiting the grave of Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام is like visiting Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام. The Imam answered in the affirmative, indicating the great merit and significance of this ziyārah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3180 - It is narrated from Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha’ that he asked Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (as) about the visitation of the grave of Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) and whether it is similar to the visitation of Husayn (as), peace be upon him.
